name: dyn_build_contact_report_record
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The inner loop at 00C5C1BE-00C5C40C (and its twin for solver mode 1 at 00C5BD90-00C5C029), x87 at 24-bit precision, every expression transcribed in listing order and float32. Per contact point (stride 30h from manifold+08h: normal at +00h, local point on body A at +0Ch, on body B at +18h, a scalar at +24h) it writes a 58h-byte record: +00h = A's 3x4 transform applied to the first local point, +0Ch = B's applied to the second, +18h = the normal copied, +24h = normal*s, +30h = normal*(-s), +3Ch and +48h zeroed, +54h never written. The transform is p' = px*row0 + py*row1 + pz*row2 + t with rows at body+08h/+14h/+20h and t at body+2Ch, the same layout bsp/rigid_body_integration.hpp declares. The listing forms the sums as (py*row1 + px*row0) + pz*row2 + t; float addition is commutative so the reordering is not a divergence. docs/DYN_CONTACT_SOLVER.md; reports/dyn_step.json
